accepted_edits.original_text: Inverse-designed nanophotonic neural network accelerators have been developed to enable ultra-compact optical computing by leveraging non-mesh topologies.
accepted_edits.reason: Genuinely redundant sentence that repeats the claim made in the immediately preceding sentence without adding new data, citations, or nuance.

accepted_edits.original_text: Diffractive optical neural networks (DONNs) provide a static, passive alternative to programmable Mach-Zehnder interferometer meshes, which offer universal unitary transformations through active tuning.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Diffractive optical neural networks (DONNs) implement linear transformations via physical diffraction layers, offering a static, passive alternative to the actively tuned, power-hungry Mach-Zehnder interferometer meshes.
accepted_edits.reason: Removes the generic 'provide an alternative' scaffold and enters directly through the physical mechanism (diffraction layers) to vary rhythm from the previous paragraph.

edit.original_text: Deep learning surrogates accelerate evaluation, yet the underlying inverse design of photonic structures often involves complex, irregular objective functions with oscillatory behavior that necessitate advanced optimization strategies to avoid local minima.
edit.replacement_text: Complex, irregular objective functions with oscillatory behavior characterize the underlying inverse design of photonic structures, necessitating advanced optimization strategies to avoid local minima despite the acceleration provided by deep learning surrogates.
edit.reason: Shifts focus from the surrogate tool to the physical/mathematical challenge (oscillatory objective functions) to improve lucidity and avoid repetitive 'Tool X does Y' syntax.

chapters.chapter_title: Photonic AI Acceleration within Scalable Photonic Computing Systems: Workload Mapping, Co-Design, and Performance Benchmarks

accepted_edits.original_text: Photonic neural networks establish a distinct operational advantage for inference by leveraging the inherent physical properties of light to execute linear algebra naturally, building on the physical constraints of precision and noise established in prior sections.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Photonic neural networks leverage the inherent physical properties of light to execute linear algebra naturally, establishing a distinct operational advantage for inference within the precision and noise constraints defined in prior sections.

accepted_edits.original_text: The DANTE framework exemplifies this hybrid approach by employing dual-neuron optical-artificial learning, where optical neurons handle forward propagation while electronic artificial neurons manage complex weight updates during training.
accepted_edits.reason: This sentence is a verbatim redundancy of the immediately preceding sentence describing the DANTE framework.

accepted_edits.original_text: Advanced inverse design strategies now employ machine learning to bridge the gap between abstract device requirements and physical realization, building on the necessity for co-design established in the previous section.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Machine learning now drives advanced inverse design strategies to bridge the gap between abstract device requirements and physical realization.
accepted_edits.reason: Eliminate the repetitive scaffold 'building on the necessity...' and tighten the subject-verb structure.

accepted_edits.original_text: Recent work has demonstrated inverse-designed nanophotonic neural network accelerators that achieve ultra-compact optical computing capabilities.
accepted_edits.reason: This sentence redundantly restates the claim made in the opening sentence of the paragraph without adding new data or citations.

accepted_edits.original_text: Architectural innovations like heterogeneous integration and single-shot processing address physical scaling, but the reliability of these systems depends on rigorous uncertainty quantification and efficient design workflows.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Rigorous uncertainty quantification and efficient design workflows determine the reliability of photonic systems, even as architectural innovations like heterogeneous integration and single-shot processing address physical scaling.
accepted_edits.reason: Shift focus to the paragraph's actual topic (uncertainty/reliability) rather than starting with the previous section's topic (scaling).

accepted_edits.original_text: ODNN research faces critical open questions regarding the path to functional, system-level photonic AI accelerators, building on acknowledged limitations in uncertainty quantification and the absence of standardized benchmarks.
accepted_edits.replacement_text: Critical open questions regarding the path to functional, system-level photonic AI accelerators persist in ODNN research, particularly concerning uncertainty quantification and the absence of standardized benchmarks.
accepted_edits.reason: Remove the weak scaffold 'building on' and improve the rhythmic flow of the concluding paragraph.
